name: Pirate Queen’s Strength
body:
The Pirate Queen sometimes answers your calls when you tread dangerous waters.

Benefit(s): Once per day when attempting a Swim check, you can treat the water as if it were one category calmer (as if stormy water were rough water or rough water were calm water).
